title: NBI to file estafa, environmental raps vs pet crematorium owner, 3 others over animal dumping
summary: The National Bureau of Investigation is set to file criminal charges against four individuals allegedly involved in the improper disposal of deceased pets in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan.
